upstream_source.provider: Fillout through the existing Google Sheets/Drive bridge
upstream_source.production_vs_old_scaffold: The Dashboard production defaults point to Employment Application Form. A separate August 6 Drive sheet named Fillout Applications is an empty scaffold and must not be treated as production.
upstream_source.reconnect_history: Dashboard code documents a Fillout integration reconnect on 2026-08-14 and explicitly changed deduplication so Sheet row numbers are not identity.
upstream_source.resume_transport: Direct upload URL from the source submission is primary; configured Drive resume folder is only a fallback.

import_identity.preferred: stable Fillout Submission ID when present
import_identity.fallback: normalized applicant name plus submission timestamp for legacy rows
import_identity.prohibited: Google Sheet row number as durable identity

privacy_and_agent_view.rule: Agent OS gets an explicit whitelisted administrative DTO, never SELECT * or a serialized SQLite row.
exclude_from_default_agent_view: local machine paths unless a document action specifically requires them
privacy_and_agent_view.employment_decision_boundary: Agent tools may organize, summarize, track documents/status/scheduling and prepare user-directed drafts, but must not rank applicants, recommend employment outcomes, or make hiring/rejection decisions.

current_code_guarantees: Content-based import identity survives a Fillout Sheet reconnect/reorder.
Restricted self-identification columns are excluded from the ordinary application PDF and routed to a separate form.
The restricted form is stored separately from the ordinary application browsing path.
Database migrations are additive and application data is backed up on startup.
Communication tracking distinguishes draft creation from user-confirmed send state.
Submitted timestamps are normalized across legacy/current source formats.
agent_adapter_requirements: Use stable applicant/source IDs and immutable event IDs.
Add an append-only local event history/outbox; mutable dashboard rows alone are insufficient for cross-agent chronology.
Expose document metadata separately from document content.
Audit applicant-record reads and prepared actions locally.
Do not expose raw Google credentials or direct source rows through Agent OS.
Preserve Dashboard usability when Agent OS is unavailable.
